return 0 when there are no error-severity findings

requirements.verifier_assertion: TestConfigFileFindings::test_config_not_found + test_config_file_stops_further_analysis — missing config yields exactly one finding with rule code `config-not-found`, file and line null, and stops further scan. must_include: do not scan the template files at all

requirements.verifier_assertion: TestQuestionFindings — literal default not in literal choices yields `default-not-in-choices`; multiselect: default must be a subset of choices.
must_include: every element of the default list must be among the choices

requirements.verifier_assertion: TestQuestionFindings — choices that are neither list nor mapping, or compound entries missing `value`, or non-string `validator` → `invalid-choices`.
TestQuestionFindings::test_templated_default_is_not_checked / test_templated_choices_are_not_checked — values containing `{{` or `{%` are not statically checked.
TestQuestionFindings — `multiselect: true` without declared `choices` → `multiselect-without-choices` error.
TestQuestionFindings — `secret: true` without a default → `secret-without-default` error.
TestQuestionFindings — bad `when` (non-bool-non-string or broken Jinja) → `invalid-when`; bad `validator` (non-string or broken Jinja) → `invalid-validator`; valid `when: '{{ true }}'` unflagged.
TestQuestionFindings — non-string `help` → `invalid-help` warning; non-string `placeholder` → `invalid-placeholder` warning.

TestSettingFindings — shape/type/value errors in _envops / _templates_suffix / _preserve_symlinks / _tasks / _migrations / _answers_file / _min_copier_version → `invalid-setting` errors. Exception (2026-09-19 QC fix): a non-list `_exclude` is an `invalid-setting` WARNING, not an error — copier's loader merges it via list.extend() and never rejects it, so the runtime-parity rule applies.
TestSettingFindings — non-PEP440 `_min_copier_version` → `invalid-setting`; `_min_copier_version: '999.0'` → `min-copier-version-too-new` warning; `1.0` (older) → no warning.
must_include: higher than the currently running copier version
